A small library for fetching information from deltarpm packages

name: drpm
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.5.3"

package:
  name: drpm
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rpm-software-management/drpm/archive/${{ version }}/drpm-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 33b6337a07af2874835321d802c62cca0e6bd8ae18c4534ce1fe68f7bcf762bc

build:
  number: 0
  skip: win or osx

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - make
    - cmake
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - bzip2
    - openssl
    - rpm-tools
    - liblzma-devel
    - zlib
    - zstd
    - cmocka
  run:
    # https://abi-laboratory.pro/index.php?view=timeline&l=rpm
    - ${{ pin_compatible('rpm-tools', upper_bound="x.x") }}
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('drpm', upper_bound='x') }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      # Only linked by the unit tests, which are not installed.
      - cmocka

tests:
  # drpm installs no executable, so the only way to exercise it is to compile
  # and run a caller against the installed headers, pkg-config file and library.
  # The source is inlined rather than pulled in with `files:` so that it is not
  # staged into etc/conda/test-files and shipped to everyone installing drpm.
  - script:
      - |
        cat > test_drpm.c <<'CSRC'
        #include <stddef.h>

        #include <drpm.h>

        int main(void)
        {
            drpm_make_options *opts = NULL;

            if (drpm_make_options_init(&opts) != DRPM_ERR_OK)
                return 1;
            if (drpm_make_options_defaults(opts) != DRPM_ERR_OK)
                return 1;
            if (drpm_make_options_destroy(&opts) != DRPM_ERR_OK)
                return 1;

            return 0;
        }
        CSRC
      # -rpath because the test environment does not put $PREFIX/lib on the
      # loader path, so the binary would build but not run.
      - $CC $(pkg-config --cflags drpm) test_drpm.c $(pkg-config --libs drpm) -Wl,-rpath,"$PREFIX/lib" -o test_drpm
      - ./test_drpm
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - pkg-config
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      lib:
        - drpm
      include:
        - drpm.h
      files:
        - include/drpm.h
        - lib/libdrpm.*
        - lib/pkgconfig/drpm.pc

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause AND LGPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.BSD
    - COPYING
  summary: A small library for fetching information from deltarpm packages
  homepage: https://github.com/rpm-software-management/drpm/
  repository: https://github.com/rpm-software-management/drpm/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chrisburr
